topics.title: F1 takes a weekend break before Austin
topics.summary: Formula 1 had no race on October 17–18, with the championship on a scheduled break after Singapore and before the United States Grand Prix. The next round is set for October 23–25 at Circuit of The Americas in Austin. It’s a quiet patch in the calendar, which is rare enough to feel suspicious.
topics.detail: The official 2026 calendar lists Singapore as the previous round from October 9–11 and the United States Grand Prix as the next race from October 23–25. Race coverage and schedule listings published during the window also noted that there were no Formula 1 sessions on October 17 or 18. One report framed the weekend as a pause between Singapore and Austin.

topics.title: EU lawmakers back high-speed rail push
topics.summary: The European Parliament’s transport committee adopted recommendations to accelerate the rollout of Europe’s high-speed rail network. The draft resolution calls for stronger links between major urban centres and neighbouring countries, plus funding support in the next EU budget cycle. Very EU-core stuff, but with actual rail attached to it.
topics.detail: The committee approved the recommendations on October 5, and the resolution was set to go to a plenary vote during the Parliament’s second October session. The text says high-speed rail should support competitiveness, territorial cohesion, modal shift, climate neutrality and strategic autonomy. It also calls for adequate funding through the Connecting Europe Facility and continued support in national and regional partnership plans.

sources.title: MEPs adopt proposed resolution on development of high-speed rail
